credits_text: DANIELLE MALENOCK PATRICK DEAL "THERE'S SOMETHING IN THE WOODS" MATTHEW MCBRADT WITH ERIN STEVENS, STEVEN SOMMERS, CHRIS GONZALEZ, JESSICA BREAL AND CHRISTOPHER TOPPER. WRITTEN AND DIRECTED BY JERRY GONZALEZ.
description: A man and woman hold a lantern and axe in a dark forest, facing a looming, shadowy figure with glowing eyes and a skull-like face.
